entry.value: This component generates ProteoVisualizer (PV) child table-view definitions for statistical comparisons, ratios, LIMPA results, LIMMA contrasts, or other comparison-based result columns.%%00010%%00010For every comparison listed in the component settings, one child table view is created for every line in Child Table view definitions. Filters, sorting, empty-value handling, and expansion of grouped columns are encoded into the generated PV records.%%00010%%00010The generated table views are returned as newline-delimited JSON in a single output-table cell. This content can subsequently be appended to the PV table-views database.%%00010%%00010Input%%00010%%00010The input table must contain all columns referenced by the comparison definitions and common definitions.%%00010%%00010The component reads the input-table schema. It does not modify the input data rows.%%00010%%00010Output%%00010%%00010The output contains one row and one column:%%00010%%00010table_views_ndjson%%00010%%00010Each line inside the output cell represents one generated PV child table-view record.%%00010%%00010Create a backup of the original PV table-views database before inserting generated records. Older generated records with identical names should be removed before inserting a replacement set.%%00010%%00010Configuration%%00010Comparisons column name prefix%%00010%%00010Enter the exact text that appears before each comparison name in the relevant input-table columns.%%00010%%00010Comparison-result column names are constructed by direct concatenation:%%00010%%00010comparison prefix + comparison name + result suffix%%00010%%00010No underscore, period, space, or other separator is inserted automatically. Any required separator must therefore be included in the prefix, comparison name, or result suffix.%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010Comparison prefix:%%00010COMP_results_%%00010%%00010Comparison:%%00010GroupA-GroupB%%00010%%00010Result suffix:%%00010.logFC%%00010%%00010Resulting column name:%%00010%%00010COMP_results_GroupA-GroupB.logFC%%00010%%00010The prefix may refer to LIMMA, LIMPA, calculated ratios, or any other comparison-result family.%%00010%%00010Comparisons list%%00010%%00010Enter the comparison names in the order in which their child table views should appear in PV.%%00010%%00010Comparisons may be separated by commas, line breaks, or both.%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010GroupA-GroupB,%%00010GroupA-GroupC,%%00010GroupB-GroupC,%%00010Treatment-Control,%%00010(Treatment-Control)-(GroupA-GroupB),%%00010(Treatment-Control)+(GroupA-GroupB)/2%%00010%%00010Characters such as parentheses, plus signs, minus signs, and slashes are preserved as part of the comparison name.%%00010%%00010The order entered in this field is preserved in the generated PV table views.%%00010%%00010Child Table view definitions%%00010%%00010Each non-empty line defines one child table-view type. The definition is applied independently to every comparison.%%00010%%00010The general structure is:%%00010%%00010"view name prefix", "view name suffix", (comparison-column directive), ...%%00010%%00010The generated table-view name is:%%00010%%00010view name prefix + comparison name + view name suffix%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010"", " - DOWN, significant", (".logFC" < "-1", sort=asc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" < "0.05", empty=false)%%00010"", " - DOWN, NOT significant", (".logFC" < "-1", sort=asc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" >= "0.05", empty=false)%%00010"", " - UP, significant", (".logFC" > "1", sort=desc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" < "0.05", empty=false)%%00010"", " - UP, NOT significant", (".logFC" > "1", sort=desc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" >= "0.05", empty=false)%%00010%%00010For the comparison GroupA-GroupB, the first line creates:%%00010%%00010GroupA-GroupB - DOWN, significant%%00010%%00010The order of the definition lines is preserved within each comparison.%%00010%%00010Directive syntax%%00010%%00010Each comparison-specific directive must be enclosed in parentheses:%%00010%%00010("result suffix" operator "threshold", option=value, ...)%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010(".logFC" > "1", sort=desc, empty=false)%%00010%%00010The result suffix is appended directly after the comparison name. No separator is added automatically.%%00010%%00010Filter operators%%00010%%00010Supported symbolic operators are:%%00010%%00010~ contains%%00010!~ not contains%%00010= equal%%00010== equal%%00010> greater%%00010>= greater or equal%%00010< less%%00010<= less or equal%%00010* regular expression%%00010%%00010Text forms such as contains, less, greater or equal, and regular expression are also accepted.%%00010%%00010Empty-value option%%00010%%00010Use:%%00010%%00010empty=true%%00010%%00010to retain rows with missing values in the filtered column.%%00010%%00010Use:%%00010%%00010empty=false%%00010%%00010to exclude missing values.%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010(".adj.P.Val" < "0.05", empty=false)%%00010Sorting option%%00010%%00010Sorting can be defined directly inside a filter directive:%%00010%%00010(".logFC" > "1", sort=desc, empty=false)%%00010%%00010Supported sorting values are:%%00010%%00010sort=asc%%00010sort=desc%%00010sort=auto%%00010sort=none%%00010%%00010sort=auto selects descending order for greater-than filters and ascending order for less-than filters.%%00010%%00010A sort-only directive is also supported:%%00010%%00010(".logFC", sort=desc)%%00010%%00010When several directives contain sorting instructions, they are written to the generated PV view in the order in which they appear in the configuration.%%00010%%00010Child Table view common definitions%%00010%%00010Enter filters or sorting rules that should be applied to every generated child table view.%%00010%%00010Unlike comparison-specific definitions, these directives refer to complete input-table column names.%%00010%%00010Each non-empty line may contain one or more parenthesized directives.%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010("Overall.Q.Value" < "0.01", empty=false)%%00010("Detected.Sample.Count" > "2", empty=true)%%00010("Average.Abundance", sort=desc)%%00010%%00010A common directive is applied to every combination of:%%00010%%00010comparison × child table-view definition%%00010%%00010Leave this field empty when no common filters or sorting rules are required.%%00010%%00010Data table ID%%00010%%00010Enter the PV table identifier to which the generated child views belong.%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010Example_Table_123456789%%00010%%00010This value must match the table_id of the corresponding parent table view in the PV table-views database.%%00010%%00010Table views parent Table view name%%00010%%00010Enter the visible name of the parent PV table view.%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010Example Results%%00010%%00010This identifies the parent view from which the generated child views originate.%%00010%%00010Table views parent Table view ID%%00010%%00010Enter the internal PV identifier of the parent table view.%%00010%%00010Example:%%00010%%00010AbC123ExampleView%%00010%%00010The generated records use this value as parent_id.%%00010%%00010It must match the _id of the parent table-view record already present in the PV database.%%00010%%00010Generated-view behavior%%00010%%00010The component automatically:%%00010%%00010Preserves the comparison order from Comparisons list.%%00010Preserves the table-view order from Child Table view definitions within every comparison.%%00010Generates stable timestamps so PV displays the views in the configured order.%%00010Applies comparison-specific and common filters.%%00010Encodes ascending and descending sorting.%%00010Handles empty values independently for every filter.%%00010Expands grouped columns used for filtering or sorting.%%00010Calculates PV-compatible column hashes and grouped-column identifiers.%%00010Creates child records using view_data_patch, matching manually created PV child views.%%00010%%00010When a required input column is missing, the affected view may be skipped and reported by the component.%%00010%%00010Complete example%%00010Comparisons column name prefix%%00010COMP_results_%%00010Comparisons list%%00010GroupA-GroupB,%%00010GroupA-GroupC,%%00010GroupB-GroupC,%%00010Treatment-Control%%00010Child Table view definitions%%00010"", " - DOWN, significant", (".logFC" < "-1", sort=asc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" < "0.05", empty=false)%%00010"", " - DOWN, NOT significant", (".logFC" < "-1", sort=asc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" >= "0.05", empty=false)%%00010"", " - UP, significant", (".logFC" > "1", sort=desc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" < "0.05", empty=false)%%00010"", " - UP, NOT significant", (".logFC" > "1", sort=desc, empty=false), (".adj.P.Val" >= "0.05", empty=false)%%00010%%00010For four comparisons and four definition lines, the component generates:%%00010%%000104 × 4 = 16 child table views%%00010%%00010The generated order is:%%00010%%00010comparison 1, definition 1%%00010comparison 1, definition 2%%00010comparison 1, definition 3%%00010comparison 1, definition 4%%00010comparison 2, definition
